Messages.Author: Joscha Duell
Messages.Body:
Gather

+1 stealth action. Unique. Put this card in play, tapped, and choose a
younger Gangrel in your uncontrolled region. During the influence
phase, you may tap this card to move that Gangrel to your ready
region, with whatever counters he or she has, unless that Gangrel
would contest a vampire in play. Any vampire can burn this card as a
(D) action that costs 1 pool.

The card stays in game until burnt. Later in the game the chosen
vampire enters torpor. Can I move him to the ready region in my
influence-phase by tapping this card?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. It only works on uncontrolled Gangrel.

Thank you for answering even though somebody else did asking this
before (I found your answer in the meantime, next time I look before
posting).

I wonder what was the intention that the card stays in game after the
vampire enters the ready region. Just to protect him from Banishments?
To make the card weaker? I thought the answer is because he can use
it's effect more often (beside the mentionend Banishment). I fear the
card is not attractive to play with this ruling. You have to invest an
action, a pool, need a younger vampire, have to protect the card and
have to remove it afterwards for another action and pool to be able to
play another one because it's uniqueness. The effect of the card is
that you save on some influences on a highcap vampire and get him out
earlier with less poolinvestment, something you can get on a less
complicate way with Info-Highway/Dreams and Minion Tap.

Or ist there a clue I missed? Help me community ;o).

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Joscha Duell <joscha...@gmx.de> wrote:

> I wonder what was the intention that the card stays in game after the
> vampire enters the ready region.

To prevent you from turbo-Gathering.
The card is unique, and takes a 1-pool action to burn it. So you need
to spend some resources to play a second Gather.
Otherwise, it would be too easy to get a zillion free Gangrel into play.
